title: Balanced Ham Sandwich Line
exact_target: Does every finite planar point set admit a line through two of its points with at most one hundred points of imbalance between the two sides?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 136 (GREEN-048). CC BY 4.0.
